welcome.title: Welcome to RailLOOP
welcome.content: RailLOOP is a personal railway diary web app designed to help you track and manage your railway journeys, visually presenting and sharing your travel footprints.

tabRecords.title: Trip Records
tabRecords.content: This tab is your journey's command center. You can view, add, and manage all railway trip records here, or add them to your collections.

loginModal.disclaimer: By using the service after registration/login, you agree to the above agreement. Otherwise, your data will only be processed locally (frontend).
